title: Repeat
prompt: Return text repeated `times` times, joined together. ("ab", 3) gives "ababab". Zero times gives an empty string.
signature: func solve(text: String, times: int) -> String:
starter:
func solve(text: String, times: int) -> String:
	return text
hint: Start with `result = ""` and in a loop do `result += text`. (There is also a built-in `text.repeat(times)`.)
